Full summary: Applied the 8 code-review findings to the twining_triage implementation (feat/triage). Five were already applied in the working tree (verified): the stdout assertion moved before mockRestore in triage-tools.test.ts, the sqlite-backend HTTP suite in triage-api.test.ts (describe.skipIf(!HAS_SQLITE) seeding twining.db directly), deep-link routing by item.kind via deepLinkTab in main.js, the normalized stableKey DOM-stability gate in triage-view.js, and the /api/triage 500 error-path test. Newly changed this session: window_ms=Infinity now applies as an unbounded window per the §4.1 letter (triage.ts normalize accepts any number > 0; engine + HTTP tests flipped and a NaN-defaults test added). Full npm test: 107 files passed, 1401 passed | 2 skipped. npm run build clean.
Decisions: Chose to apply window_ms=Infinity as an unbounded window (cutoff -Infinity) over silently defaulting it to 7 days — supersedes the earlier treat-non-finite-as-absent choice: spec §4.1's letter is 'absent or ≤ 0 → default; no upper clamp', and Infinity is > 0. The known wrinkle (Infinity serializes to JSON null in the echoed window_ms through both adapters) is documented in normalize() and pinned by the HTTP test asserting window_ms === null with unbounded results.; Kept the lazy-once triage StoreSet in createApiHandler over the spec §7 letter (eager construction in the closure) — verified eager createStores on an uninitialized project resolves to sqlite and openDatabase would create .twining/twining.db, materializing state on a project the route must report initialized:false for, breaking the §10.11 zero-shape tests. Lazy-once satisfies the sentence's normative core (construct once, never per request — no sqlite connection churn); the fs.existsSync guard runs before getTriageStores so uninitialized projects never touch stores.; Accepted the §8 dashboard refresh-wiring test gap (mount fetch, change-gated store.subscribe refetch, tab-activation refetch untested) as repo convention — matches the existing dashboard-JS pattern (timeline-scale.test.ts, store-logic.test.ts test pure exports only; no jsdom in the vitest config). The pure routing/stability helpers (deepLinkTab, stableKey) are pinned in triage-view-logic.test.ts; wiring regressions are left to release-time Playwright smoke.
